relations.myth: The transformed rooster lays the Basilisk’s egg
relations.note: The red rooster lays the Basilisk’s egg, then becomes a Piguchén.
relations.source: Cavada, Chiloé y los chilotes, p. 109

relations.myth: Great serpent shattered during a lunar cosmic catastrophe
relations.note: Individual Piwichen arise from fragments of the shattered primordial serpent.
